value.title: A Sneak Peek Into How A Global Finance Firm Discovers Hidden Gems

content.subtitle: Have you ever wondered how much raw talent you could unearth from your own team? Well, it isn’t a difficult task, if you’re up for it.

paragraphs.name: 30fa
paragraphs.text: A Sneak Peek Into How A Global Finance Firm Discovers Hidden Gems
Have you ever stepped into a jewellery store and taken a good look at a diamond? Chances are, you haven’t unless you’ve been shopping for a proposal.

paragraphs.name: 335c
paragraphs.text: But whether you’re a diamond lover or not, diamonds are among the most coveted gems in the world. And naturally so. It takes years and a dedicated team of geologists to discover diamonds, let alone quality ones. Regardless, upon sighting, diamonds tend to bring a sense of excitement.

paragraphs.name: b339
paragraphs.text: You might be wondering, “Hmmm, but what do diamonds have to do with me?”

paragraphs.name: 253d
paragraphs.text: At work, your employees are akin to diamonds. They may come to work each day, complete their tasks and go home without uttering a word. But dig deeper and you might notice that these same individuals are working tirelessly away, often under the radar, going the extra mile to help a customer solve a problem or perhaps assist a fellow colleague in dire need of help. Imagine if you could tap into the full potential of such employees.

paragraphs.name: cbaa
paragraphs.text: What if instead of looking for talent outside, you could unearth rare gems from amongst your very own team members? According to the Society for Human Resource Management, you’d then have saved your organisation $4,129 in hiring costs. Not to mention weeks of onboarding, training and lost productivity!

paragraphs.name: 1e90
paragraphs.text: So how do you find these diamonds or hidden gems? Read on to discover an all-encompassing yet simple strategy you can use to mine for hidden gems within your organisation.

paragraphs.name: 2b73
paragraphs.text: Challenge

paragraphs.name: ba39
paragraphs.text: In Q1 of 2022, PhillipCapital, an integrated Asian Financial House with a global presence, reached out to us about their initiative to equip their non-IT employees with programming skills as part of their Learn and Hack journey.

paragraphs.name: c9e8
paragraphs.text: “Over the past year, we’ve been working with many developers to build our platforms and digital services,” Carina Seah, the Learning and Development Manager said.

paragraphs.name: 2cc5
paragraphs.text: She continued, “Our Chairman has been emphasising the importance of having all our employees possess basic coding knowledge. This year, he wishes to take this further and encourage digitalisation. And we are looking for high-potential employees to lead this change.”
Our client wanted to identify hidden gems within the organisation that could propel the company to greater heights.

paragraphs.name: 4def
paragraphs.text: With that in mind, we set out to curate a robust training programme; one that would help us sieve out the diamonds and prime them for more challenging future projects.

paragraphs.name: 2dcb
paragraphs.text: Solution

paragraphs.name: adb5
paragraphs.text: We proposed a web development course as it offered numerous opportunities for assessing employees on various technical and soft skills characteristic of high potential employees.

paragraphs.name: 61ca
paragraphs.text: While our primary goal was to identify talented individuals, we also aimed to provide a strong foundation in web technologies (HTML, CSS and JavaScript) to all participants.

paragraphs.name: 451a
paragraphs.text: Introducing HTML

paragraphs.name: ec00
paragraphs.text: We kicked off our training programme with a birds-eye view into the structure and workings of the Internet and the World Wide Web. Soon after, participants proceeded to hack* websites to practise their newly acquired skills.
Below is an amusing example from one of our participants:

paragraphs.name: b858
paragraphs.text: None of the participants hacked any website. These were changes made locally on their own browsers.

paragraphs.name: 4e8f
paragraphs.text: Unsurprisingly, this exercise allowed us to identify a few hidden gems among our participants. These select few individuals displayed an intense desire and motivation to learn. And in doing so, they were able to quickly extract and modify various HTML elements of a website without much guidance!

paragraphs.name: 70ed
paragraphs.text: Following this exercise, we continued to dive deeper into the foundation of HTML tags and crafted our own profile pages for a person of our choice.

Once again, we were impressed by the technical proficiency of a handful of our participants. Not only did they explore the use of basic HTML tags such as headers and images, but they also went above and beyond to add GIFs, embed YouTube videos and more! (see below).

paragraphs.name: baa4
paragraphs.text: Examples of profile pages created by the participants

paragraphs.name: 8f30
paragraphs.text: Notwithstanding, there was, of course, a handful of stragglers who couldn’t keep up not so much due to their lack of ability but more so because they had no prior coding experience.

paragraphs.name: 5d41
paragraphs.text: For them, we offered differentiated instructions. Advanced learners were tasked to build fully-functional HTML pages whereas beginners new to HTML were guided along via targeted hands-on challenges.

paragraphs.name: a995
paragraphs.text: Exploring CSS

paragraphs.name: f1a7
paragraphs.text: After HTML, it was time to delve into CSS — a nifty language used to dress average-looking websites fabulously.

paragraphs.name: a2a6
paragraphs.text: Since we had already identified the hidden gems in the organisation, it was now necessary to observe these individuals’ emotional intelligence. As future leaders, it was essential for them to have strong communication and people skills.

paragraphs.name: d0f3
paragraphs.text: As such, we proposed a team challenge — to beautify a website using CSS customisation features.

paragraphs.name: ba42
paragraphs.text: To our surprise, not only did many of the top performers exhibit strong camaraderie, but many other participants also proactively sought help and built upon each other’s ideas.

paragraphs.name: 14d6
paragraphs.text: Most importantly, the individuals we selected also showed a keen interest in stretching themselves further. They rallied their teams together to Google for possible refinements while keeping track of time.

paragraphs.name: cd2b
paragraphs.text: Diving Into JavaScript

paragraphs.name: 748b
paragraphs.text: With HTML and CSS completed, we were left with the last web technology of the course — JavaScript. As it turned out, this programming language afforded the perfect means to identify individuals with a relentless drive.

paragraphs.name: a7f5
paragraphs.text: With its complex syntax and advanced interactivity capabilities, JavaScript threw many of our participants into a state of disarray. Despite this, a handful was able to persevere through the challenges and emerge victorious.

paragraphs.name: 5f55
paragraphs.text: Some of the key takeaways from this segment were alerts and prompts, buttons, text inputs, functions, and the manipulation of the Document Object Model (DOM). Participants were also introduced to JS libraries such as Chart.js that they could tap on to quickly enhance a web page’s functionality.

paragraphs.name: a7c1
paragraphs.text: Akmal (front left) teaching participants JavaScript and providing examples for them to follow.

paragraphs.name: 3cc1
paragraphs.text: Before we ended the programme, we decided to throw in a final challenge. This time around, the challenge was focused on a work-based scenario. Participants had to create their own custom forms to collect important information from their customers.
As the culmination of the 3-day training, this challenge was undoubtedly gruelling in every way and form.

paragraphs.name: a4d1
paragraphs.text: However, despite the heightened complexity, many teams rose to the occasion. We watched in awe as they tenaciously applied all that they learned to this work-related challenge.

paragraphs.name: 05f5
paragraphs.text: Outcomes

Indeed by the end of this intensive training course, we were amazed by many participants, most of whom had never coded in their life but displayed so much learning agility and resilience in stepping out of their comfort zones.

paragraphs.name: 1de9
paragraphs.text: Although we didn’t turn anyone into professional web developers (impossible with a short course), we noticed that many were nonetheless eager to continue their learning and development journey. In fact, many participants mentioned that the course had opened their eyes to the ease of picking up new skills!

paragraphs.name: ef4c
paragraphs.text: We were assured that our course met all our goals — finding the hidden gems as well as equipping all our participants with adequate web development skills and a learner’s mindset that would serve them favourably in future projects, regardless of the job roles or positions they held.

Are you eager to discover the hidden gems within your organisation? Or are you perhaps interested in developing your workforce for the digital future? Reach out to us at hello@tk.sg and we’ll be glad to design a programme for you!
